verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party pages say Tap to Pay turns a smartphone into a checkout. It accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets over WiFi or cellular, and the POS app runs on iOS and Android, so the core of the story (contactless payments on a phone without a reader) is delivered. Missing for 10: supported device and region eligibility details, an explicit statement that no separate reader purchase is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Tap to Pay working.
